_note: Task-level evals: verify the skill runs the bundled audit (not a reimplementation), reports the non-additive accounting model correctly, and never mutates config. burn-rate is read-only, so these are safe to run with the skill-creator harness against real local transcripts.

evals.prompt: Audit my Claude Code token spend for the last week and tell me where my tokens are going. Skip the ccusage baseline — just use my local transcript data.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the bundled audit (audit.py --skip-ccusage), then summarizes the largest cost surfaces from the local deduplicated transcript usage. It presents an opportunity ranking rather than a single summed 'total savings' number, and notes that ccusage was skipped.
expectations: The skill executed the bundled scripts/audit.py rather than reimplementing token accounting inline
The audit was run with --skip-ccusage (ccusage baseline not required)
The summary ranks optimization opportunities (opportunity_ranking) instead of presenting a single additive total_weekly_savings_usd figure
The response does not claim a fabricated grand-total savings number; it reflects that total_savings.status is 'not_reported' because detector scopes overlap
No configuration files were edited or written (read-only diagnosis)

evals.prompt: I keep hitting my weekly Claude Code limit. Which projects or workflows are burning the most tokens, and is anything running away on its own?
evals.expected_output: The skill attributes spend by project / skill / plugin / agent (bottlenecks), classifies high-volume projects as parallel workload rather than 'runaway', and only flags possible recurring automation when multiple scheduling signals align.
expectations: The skill executed the bundled scripts/audit.py to gather attribution data
Spend is attributed by project and by skill/plugin/agent dimension (bottlenecks / attribution)
A high-volume project is described as a high-volume parallel workload, NOT labeled 'runaway' on session count alone
Any automation claim is hedged and tied to multiple aligned signals, not asserted from volume alone
No configuration files were edited or written

evals.prompt: Give me a quick read-only token audit of Claude Code. Do not change any of my settings or files — I only want a diagnosis.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the audit, reports findings (model routing, cache, CLAUDE.md, causal diagnostics) with their basis, and makes zero modifications to any file or config.
expectations: The skill executed the bundled scripts/audit.py
Findings are reported with their basis label (spend / causal / workload / mixed)
No Edit or Write tool calls were made; no settings.json, CLAUDE.md, or any other file was modified
The response makes clear it is a diagnosis only and applies no fixes automatically
